_note: bodies-director-remuneration (bod-17): what a position holder is paid, per year. Declarative only: a schema with its read rule, and manifest widgets. Members do not read each other's pay unless it is disclosed, so the read rule names the secretariat and administrators plus a public rule on disclosed records whose publication date has passed, and deliberately not authenticated.

MandateRemuneration.title: Remuneration
MandateRemuneration.description: What the holder of a position on a body is paid in one year: a fixed fee, a fee per meeting attended and an expense allowance, with the decision that set it and whether it is disclosed.

positionHold.title: Position held
positionHold.description: The position hold this remuneration is for.

person.title: Person
person.description: The person who holds the position.

governanceBody.title: Body
governanceBody.description: The body the position is on.

year.title: Year
year.description: The calendar year the amounts are for.

setByDecision.title: Set by decision
setByDecision.description: The decision that set these amounts.

disclosed.title: Disclosed
